accepted_contract: For arbitrary equal-length finite u64 clocks and a valid sender, is_causally_ready_spec(message, local, sender) implies happens_before_spec(local, merge_spec(local, message)).

independent_verification.scope: All proofs/executable contracts in the complete five-module dependency closure plus both model proofs; no module filter.

trust_scope: Hash-matched algebraic, ordering, pointwise, vector_clock and causal_order sources only, plus standard vstd. No new domain trust escapes and no unrelated hash/version/codec axioms.
parent_corrections: The general theorem is not restricted to three processes; the unconditional example is a concrete three-process satisfiability witness.
Readiness permits a nonsender LOCAL counter to exceed its MESSAGE counterpart, not the other way round. The runtime example demonstrates why merging is necessary.
No consistent-cut, whole distributed-protocol, network or runtime cryptographic guarantee is claimed.

advisory_opportunities.status: Unverified composition proposal only; named APIs were located in actual source. Empty intervals, resource identity, validity-time scope and interval correspondence remain explicit bridge obligations.

Unverified composition proposal only; actual APIs located. Tuple counts are not unique authenticated voter sets; n>0, membership, uniqueness and authentication are needed before a count-intersection theorem can support a set-intersection claim.

novelty_limit: Absence of a direct import or a symbol-name match is not an exhaustive proof of non-duplication. No global novelty claim accepted for the advisory proposals.
production_integration: None. This is an independently checked research witness, not a new production-exported API.
